correctness.rationale: RESULT.md lines 4–22 and 41–57 reconstruct by parsing uniquely into ground flats and arches UF^aD. Splitting t arches at the h−1 positive intervening gaps, marking q positive interiors, and positively composing f flats across the s ordered marked runs are independent choices. The unigram counts must be U=D=t and F=f; with these counts the displayed nine digram values are necessary and the construction is sufficient. The all-flat case includes the empty word. For singleton size, h=1 or t and q=0 or t (without duplication at t=1); the flat allocation is unique for s=f=0, s=1, or f=s≥2. Summing these cases gives the displayed series, including the unrestricted one-run correction for t=2,h=2,q=0. Its only double pole is at 1, with coefficient 1 of (1−z)^{-2}. Independently, choosing the positions of an even number of vertical steps determines the source, giving 2^{n−1} for n≥1. Fresh bounded corroboration: iterate masks of n vertical positions through n=17, fill the marked positions alternately U,D, and tally all 12 raw multiplicities. Across 1,709 realized profiles the counts agreed with the binomial law; the singleton values matched the series and table. UFDFF and UFFDF collide at length five, and no binomial factor can exceed one below five. Inspected frozen VERIFICATION.md and verify.py; their status is not an independent audit, and the script was not executed. The reconstruction proves the all-length claim, separately from enumeration.
